entities.name: French Encroachment and Missionary Activity
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: French missionaries and settlers gradually established a presence despite the island's official neutral status. French planters developed coffee and sugar estates, importing enslaved Africans, while the Kalinago were pushed into increasingly marginal territory.
